title: Between Periods
tagline: It's intermission and the ice is wrecked. Steer the machine, ration your water, and buff every scar before the buzzer.
description: It is intermission and the rink is a wreck: skate grooves, divots and one seeded mishap. Steer an ice-resurfacing machine that cannot turn on a dime, ration one tank of water, and buff every scar to a mirror gleam before the buzzer. Every UTC day brings its own rink, and your finish becomes a spoiler-safe postcard and a challenge link a friend can try to beat.

makingOf: A fixed-step simulation (60 ticks a second, in logical rink coordinates) scores against a typed-array grid, never canvas pixels, so one seed and one set of inputs always earn the same grade on any screen. Self-tests replay scripted routes with the ticks fed in chunks of 1, 7 and 60 and compare every result, check that a bot driving closed laps gleams at least 95 percent of the scars on each of the next 365 daily rinks, and check that the best of three bot planners (skip-lane mow, spiral, racetrack) out-scores the plain mow. Everything is game scale: the rink is stylized; the machine, its mishaps and every number are invented. One pass has three zones (shave, wash, squeegee), a simplification of a machine that shaves, washes, vacuums and floods in one pass. As of 2026-10-12: the 2026-27 NHL season opened on 29 September 2026 (per nhl.com and Yahoo Sports); a resurfacing pass shaves a thin layer, carries the shavings by augers to a snow tank, sprays water and picks up dirty water with a vacuum and squeegee (per HowStuffWorks and Wikipedia); the 1949 Model A's four-wheel steering was cut back to front-wheel steering after it jammed against the boards (per Wikipedia and the maker's own history PDF). Seeding a daily puzzle from the date is common practice (per three craft write-ups listed below).
